⏺ User answered Claude's questions:
  ⎿  · Measured on Claude 2.1.318 and Codex 0.160.1: in both /model pickers, Enter SAVES the pick as your default for
     new sessions (~/.claude/settings.json, ~/.codex/config.toml); only the picker's `s` key is "this session only".
     Claude's `/model <name>` with an argument also saves the default. What should choosing a model from the chat do? →
     Save as default
     · Claude's MCP prompts (e.g. /mcp__kicad__routing_strategy) are known only inside the running Claude process: no
     file lists them, and the one listing API (a `claude -p` initialize sidecar) ran an UNTRUSTED repo's SessionStart
     hook in my test (ADR 0001). How should the chat's command list treat MCP prompts? → leave them out for now

⏺ You answered both questions:

  - /model: Save as default, which is not the recommended option. Picking a model from the chat will work like pressing
    Enter in the terminal: it becomes the default for new sessions and gets written to ~/.claude/settings.json or
    ~/.codex/config.toml. The chat's confirmation should say that it saves a default.
  - MCP prompts: Leave them out for now. The chat's command list will show built-ins, your own and project commands and
    skills, and plugin commands. MCP prompts stay terminal-only, and the proposal will record why: the only way to list
    them ran an untrusted repo's SessionStart hook (ADR 0001).
